title: Elridge Kuyper and the Gabriel family
summary: Allen asks about Kuyper, and Lewis mentions the Gabriel musicians who went to Detroit.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family

Well that's the one who used to work with me. Elridge Kuyfer, Kid Kuyfer? Yeah, yeah, yeah. Yeah, mm-hmm.
